chunks: From him, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdillah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

I asked him about a man who buys a female slave, has sexual intercourse with her, and then finds her to be pregnant. He said: 'He returns her, and returns with her something (a portion of the price).'

key_terms.فَيَقَعُ عَلَيْهَا: He has intercourse with her / consummates possession

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man buys a female slave and finds she is pregnant after intercourse?
ai.summary: In the context of *tahdhib al-ahkam*, this narration clarifies that pre-existing pregnancy constitutes a hidden defect (*'ibbah*) warranting the right of return (*khiyar al-'ibb*). The phrase 'return with something' indicates a partial deduction from the price rather than a full refund, reflecting the juristic consensus that the buyer retains the value of the period before discovery. This ruling underscores the Shia emphasis on transparency in transactions and the protection of the buyer's rights against undisclosed conditions.
